#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Standalone recount of the SaTML-candidate headline numbers (methodology_pcrl_acs, 2026-10-01).

No repository imports. Reads git blobs via `git show <ref>:<path>`, hashes the exact blob bytes,
recomputes each headline quantity from stored fields, and prints a JSON list.
"""
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from statistics import NormalDist

REPO = '/Users/nathansamson/PCRL'
TD = 'f4bdf4cd5bf74c634feeec50aef78bff249667e4'   # research/pcrl-task-directed-release-v1
FP = '5e154e5c4fdaeb23d327a0ebefe838525f1a19cb'   # research/pcrl-final-prospective-v1
SUB = '55c0c5a358eea193e6d2293a2c814a5435487d14'  # research/pcrl-submission-finish-v1
TDR = 'results/pcrl_task_directed_release_v1/'
FPR = 'results/pcrl_final_prospective_v1/'
Q, D17, D33 = 'T0_L_0.01_a17', 'T0_U_unconstrained_a17', 'T0_U_unconstrained_a33'
N = NormalDist()
_cache = {}


def blob(ref, path):
    key = (ref, path)
    if key not in _cache:
        raw = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', REPO, 'show', f'{ref}:{path}'], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
        oid = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', REPO, 'rev-parse', f'{ref}:{path}'], check=True,
                             capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
        _cache[key] = (raw, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), oid)
    return _cache[key]


def js(ref, path):
    return json.loads(blob(ref, path)[0])


rows = []


def add(quantity, manuscript_value, location, ref, path, field, stored, recomputed, method, match, notes=''):
    raw, sha, oid = blob(ref, path)
    rows.append({'quantity': quantity, 'manuscript_value': manuscript_value, 'manuscript_location': location,
                 'ref': ref, 'path': path, 'blob_sha': oid, 'sha256': sha, 'field_path': field,
                 'stored_value': stored, 'recomputed_value': recomputed, 'method': method,
                 'match': bool(match), 'notes': notes})


MAIN = f'{SUB[:9]}:papers/pcrl_satml_final_v1/main.tex'

# ---------------- development (2018) ----------------
H = js(TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json')
u = H['nominees']['utility_first']
assert u['configuration'] == Q
for w, mv in (('unweighted', '0.01625'), ('PWGTP', '0.01639')):
    v = u['task']['loss_delta_J'][w]
    add(f'dev task improvement over J ({w})', mv, MAIN + ':278-279 (abstract :30-31 gives 0.0163)', TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json',
        f'/nominees/utility_first/task/loss_delta_J/{w}', v, round(-v, 5), 'negate loss delta; round 5 dp',
        abs(round(-v, 5) - float(mv)) < 5e-6)
    # selected - J selected
    J = H['fixed_task_path']['J']['selected'][w]
    sel = u['task']['selected'][w]
    add(f'dev task delta recomputed from selected CE ({w})', mv, MAIN + ':278', TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json',
        f'/nominees/utility_first/task/selected/{w} - /fixed_task_path/J/selected/{w}', v, sel - J,
        'CE(Q selected) - CE(J selected)', abs((sel - J) - v) < 1e-12)
ub = u['J_utility_bounds']
add('dev task adjusted bounds exclude zero (both weightings)', 'bounds excluding zero', MAIN + ':30-31,279', TD,
    TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json', '/nominees/utility_first/J_utility_bounds[*].upper',
    [b['upper'] for b in ub], all(b['upper'] < 0 for b in ub), 'all upper < 0', all(b['upper'] < 0 for b in ub))
sens = u['sensitive']
inc = {(r, w): sens[r][w]['recovery_increment_over_J'] for r in sens for w in sens[r]}
nfav = sum(v < 0 for v in inc.values())
add('dev sensitive point estimates favouring Q over J', '8 of 8', MAIN + ':31-32,299-300', TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json',
    '/nominees/utility_first/sensitive/*/*/recovery_increment_over_J', {f'{r}|{w}': v for (r, w), v in inc.items()},
    f'{nfav}/{len(inc)}', 'count increment < 0', nfav == 8 and len(inc) == 8)
pb = u['J_privacy_bounds']
resolved = [b for b in pb if b['upper'] <= 0.001]
add('dev non-inferiority bounds resolving at +0.001 cap', '1 of 8 (AB/sex unweighted, upper -0.00007); 7 unresolved',
    MAIN + ':32-33,300-301', TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json', '/nominees/utility_first/J_privacy_bounds[*].upper',
    {f"{b['role']}|{b['weighting']}": b['upper'] for b in pb},
    {'resolved': len(resolved), 'which': [f"{b['role']}|{b['weighting']}" for b in resolved],
     'upper': [round(b['upper'], 5) for b in resolved], 'passed_flags': sum(b['passed'] for b in pb)},
    'count upper <= 0.001 (registered cap, PROTOCOL.md:47)',
    len(resolved) == 1 and resolved[0]['role'] == 'attack:AB/SEX' and resolved[0]['weighting'] == 'unweighted'
    and round(resolved[0]['upper'], 5) == -0.00007,
    'Note: the cap is +0.001, so "resolves" means upper<=0.001, not upper<0; AB/SEX unweighted is also the only upper<0.')
add('dev competitive conjunction', 'not established', MAIN + ':32-33', TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json',
    '/nominees/utility_first/competitive_passed', u['competitive_passed'], u['competitive_passed'], 'read flag',
    u['competitive_passed'] is False)
PB = js(TD, TDR + 'PAIRED_BOUNDS.json')
m = PB['family_size']
z = N.inv_cdf(1 - 0.05 / (2 * m))
add('dev Bonferroni family size and critical value', 'm=706, z=3.97', MAIN + ':273-274', TD, TDR + 'PAIRED_BOUNDS.json',
    '/family_size, /critical_value_adjusted', [m, PB['critical_value_adjusted']], [m, round(z, 4)],
    'z = Phi^-1(1-0.05/(2m))', m == 706 and abs(z - PB['critical_value_adjusted']) < 1e-6)
add('dev bootstrap household union', '5,473', MAIN + ':272', TD, TDR + 'PAIRED_BOUNDS.json', '/households_union',
    PB['households_union'], H['bootstrap_households'], 'cross-check HEADLINE /bootstrap_households',
    PB['households_union'] == H['bootstrap_households'] == 5473,
    'Per-anchor test pools have 2,015 households each (anchor_household_counts); 5,473 is their union, so anchors share households.')
# symmetric normal bounds check on utility bound
b0 = PB['bounds'][ub[0]['endpoint']]
add('dev task bound = estimate +/- z*SE', f"[{ub[0]['lower']:.6f},{ub[0]['upper']:.6f}]", MAIN + ':Table II', TD,
    TDR + 'PAIRED_BOUNDS.json', f"/bounds/{ub[0]['endpoint']}", [b0['estimate'], b0['bootstrap_se']],
    [b0['estimate'] - z * b0['bootstrap_se'], b0['estimate'] + z * b0['bootstrap_se']], 'recompute from estimate and SE',
    abs(b0['estimate'] + z * b0['bootstrap_se'] - ub[0]['upper']) < 1e-9)
# Q vs D17 attribution contrasts
C = js(TD, TDR + 'CONTRASTS.json')['endpoints']
qd = []
for e in C:
    cf = {t['configuration']: t['coefficient'] for t in e['terms']}
    if set(cf) == {Q, D17}:
        bb = PB['bounds'][e['id']]
        qd.append((e['role'], e['weighting'], cf[Q], bb['estimate'], bb['lower'], bb['upper']))
unres = sum(lo <= 0 <= up for *_, lo, up in qd)
d17_lower_sens = sum(1 for role, w, cq, est, lo, up in qd if role.startswith('attack') and est > 0)
task_pts = [(w, est) for role, w, cq, est, lo, up in qd if role.startswith('utility')]
add('dev Q vs D17: adjusted differences unresolved', 'all ten unresolved', MAIN + ':308-309', TD, TDR + 'CONTRASTS.json',
    'endpoints with terms {Q:+/-1, D17:-/+1} -> /bounds/<id>', len(qd), f'{unres}/{len(qd)} intervals contain 0',
    'count lower<=0<=upper', unres == 10 and len(qd) == 10)
add('dev D17 lower sensitive point estimates than Q', '7 of 8', MAIN + ':306-307', TD, TDR + 'CONTRASTS.json',
    'sensitive contrasts CE(D17)-CE(Q) > 0', None, f'{d17_lower_sens}/8', 'count estimate > 0 (orientation D17:+1, Q:-1)',
    d17_lower_sens == 7)
add('dev D17 slightly better task point estimate', 'slightly better', MAIN + ':306', TD, TDR + 'CONTRASTS.json',
    'utility contrasts CE(Q)-CE(D17)', task_pts, all(est > 0 for w, est in task_pts), 'estimate > 0 means D17 lower loss',
    all(est > 0 for w, est in task_pts))
# null comparator (independent token) increment as finite-attacker noise calibration
NM = js(TD, TDR + 'NARRATIVE_MANIFEST.json')
for cfg, expect in (('independent_token', 'population increment over H is exactly 0 (token independent of all data)'),
                    ('constant_best', 'population increment over H is exactly 0 (constant channel)')):
    pts = [p for p in NM['primary_sensitive_points'] if p['configuration'] == cfg]
    vals = {f"{p['role']}|{p['weighting']}": p['recovery_over_H'] for p in pts}
    rng = [min(vals.values()), max(vals.values())]
    add(f'null-extension calibration: {cfg} measured recovery_over_H', 'not in manuscript (Q4 audit)', 'n/a; '
        'relevant to main.tex:127-133 and CORRECTIONS_FINAL boundaries', TD, TDR + 'NARRATIVE_MANIFEST.json',
        f'/primary_sensitive_points[configuration={cfg}]/recovery_over_H', vals, rng,
        'min/max over 4 roles x 2 weightings', True,
        expect + '; finite fitted values shown. constant_best is routed as an H release (is_H_release) so it is exactly 0 '
        'by construction; independent_token gives the finite-attacker noise floor of the increment estimator.')
q_over_h = {f"{r}|{w}": sens[r][w]['recovery_over_H'] for r in sens for w in sens[r]}
add('Q measured recovery_over_H (absolute increment vs fixed service)', 'not printed in main.tex (Table III gives J-relative only)',
    'main.tex:127-133 contract says absolute recovery beside every increment', TD, TDR + 'HEADLINE_EVIDENCE.json',
    '/nominees/utility_first/sensitive/*/*/recovery_over_H', q_over_h, [min(q_over_h.values()), max(q_over_h.values())],
    'min/max', True, 'All eight positive (0.00086-0.00614): Q adds measured recovery over H on every endpoint, while being below J.')

# ---------------- prospective (2016) ----------------
I = js(FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json')
LOC_P = MAIN + ':367-372; Table IV'
for c in ('Q', 'D17'):
    cl = I['primary'][c]['clauses']
    zc = I['primary'][c]['z_one_sided']
    recomputed_pass = 0
    task_ub = []
    for k in cl:
        ubk = k['estimate'] + zc * k['bootstrap_se']
        assert abs(ubk - k['upper_bound_97_5']) < 1e-12
        ok = ubk <= k['threshold']
        recomputed_pass += ok
        if k['clause'] == 'task':
            task_ub.append(round(ubk, 6))
    sens_ok = sum(1 for k in cl if k['clause'] != 'task' and k['estimate'] + zc * k['bootstrap_se'] <= k['threshold'])
    sens_neg = sum(1 for k in cl if k['clause'] != 'task' and k['estimate'] + zc * k['bootstrap_se'] < 0)
    add(f'prospective {c} clauses passed', '8 of 10', LOC_P, FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json', f'/primary/{c}/clauses[*]',
        I['primary'][c]['clauses_passed'], f'{recomputed_pass}/10 (sensitive {sens_ok}/8, all-below-zero {sens_neg}/8)',
        'upper = estimate + z_one_sided*SE <= threshold', recomputed_pass == 8 == I['primary'][c]['clauses_passed'] and sens_neg == 8)
    mv = {'Q': '-0.001505, -0.001871', 'D17': '-0.002913, -0.002951'}[c]
    add(f'prospective {c} task upper bounds', mv, MAIN + ':370-371', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json',
        f'/primary/{c}/clauses[clause=task].upper_bound_97_5', [k['upper_bound_97_5'] for k in cl if k['clause'] == 'task'],
        task_ub, 'estimate + 1.959964*SE, round 6 dp', [f'{x:.6f}' for x in task_ub] == mv.split(', '))
    pts = [k['estimate'] for k in cl if k['clause'] == 'task']
    add(f'prospective {c} task point estimates <= -0.003 (Downloads-PDF variant sentence)',
        'The point estimates meet the 0.003-nat improvement target', 'Downloads/PCRL_SaTML_Manuscript.pdf sec. VII (not in main.tex@55c0c5a35)',
        FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json', f'/primary/{c}/clauses[clause=task].estimate', pts, all(p <= -0.003 for p in pts),
        'all estimates <= -0.003', all(p <= -0.003 for p in pts))
qt = [k for k in I['primary']['Q']['clauses'] if k['clause'] == 'task' and k['weighting'] == 'unweighted'][0]
ratio = qt['estimate'] / u['task']['loss_delta_J']['unweighted']
add('prospective vs development effect ratio', '-0.0033 vs -0.0163, about a fifth', MAIN + ':381-382', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json',
    '/primary/Q/clauses[task,unweighted].estimate', qt['estimate'], round(ratio, 3), 'ratio to dev unweighted delta',
    round(qt['estimate'], 4) == -0.0033 and 0.18 < ratio < 0.22)
ses = [k['bootstrap_se'] for c in ('Q', 'D17') for k in I['primary'][c]['clauses'] if k['clause'] == 'task']
add('prospective realised task SE range', '0.0009-0.0011', MAIN + ':379-380', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json',
    '/primary/*/clauses[task].bootstrap_se', ses, [round(min(ses), 5), round(max(ses), 5)], 'min/max',
    0.00085 <= min(ses) and max(ses) <= 0.00115)
sec = I['secondary']
zs = N.inv_cdf(1 - sec['alpha'] / (2 * sec['family_size']))
add('prospective secondary family and z', '70 endpoints; z=3.384', 'CLAIM_LEDGER P16-5; ' + MAIN + ':411', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json',
    '/secondary/family_size, /secondary/z', [sec['family_size'], sec['z']], [len(sec['rows']), round(zs, 4)],
    'Phi^-1(1-0.05/(2*70))', sec['family_size'] == len(sec['rows']) == 70 and abs(zs - sec['z']) < 1e-9)
for comp, mv in (('RR75', '-0.011652, -0.011170'), ('W75', '-0.007055, -0.006875')):
    rr = [r for r in sec['rows'] if r['comparator'] == comp]
    task = [r for r in rr if 'utility' in r['role']]
    sensr = [r for r in rr if 'attack' in r['role']]
    # orientation for sensitive rows
    higher = sum(1 for r in sensr if (r['estimate'] - sec['z'] * r['bootstrap_se']) > 0)
    add(f'prospective Q-{comp} task estimates', mv, MAIN + ':411-413', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json',
        f'/secondary/rows[comparator={comp},utility].estimate', [r['estimate'] for r in task],
        [f"{r['estimate']:.6f}" for r in task], 'round 6 dp', [f"{r['estimate']:.6f}" for r in task] == mv.split(', '),
        f"orientations: {sorted(set(r['orientation'] for r in task))}")
    add(f'prospective Q vs {comp}: sensitive endpoints with significantly higher Q recovery', '6 of 8', MAIN + ':413-414', FP,
        FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json', f'/secondary/rows[comparator={comp},attack]', [r['orientation'] for r in sensr][:1],
        f'{higher}/{len(sensr)}', 'count estimate - z*SE > 0 under stored orientation', higher == 6 and len(sensr) == 8,
        'orientation string printed in stored_value; positive must mean Q recovers more')
for comp, mv in (('D17', '+0.001476'), ('D33', '+0.001782')):
    r = [x for x in sec['rows'] if x['comparator'] == comp and 'utility' in x['role'] and x['weighting'] == 'unweighted'][0]
    rp = [x for x in sec['rows'] if x['comparator'] == comp and 'utility' in x['role'] and x['weighting'] == 'PWGTP'][0]
    sens_sig = sum(1 for x in sec['rows'] if x['comparator'] == comp and 'attack' in x['role'] and x['excludes_zero'])
    add(f'prospective Q-{comp} unweighted task', mv + ' (interval excludes zero); PWGTP unresolved; 0/8 sensitive significant',
        'CLAIM_LEDGER P16-6; ' + MAIN + ':415-418', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json', f'/secondary/rows[comparator={comp},utility]',
        [r['estimate'], r['excludes_zero'], rp['excludes_zero']], [f"{r['estimate']:+.6f}", r['lower'] > 0, sens_sig],
        'read and check lower>0; count sensitive excludes_zero', f"{r['estimate']:+.6f}" == mv and r['lower'] > 0
        and not rp['excludes_zero'] and sens_sig == 0)
add('prospective households', '15,928', MAIN + ':361', FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json', '/households', I['households'], I['households'],
    'read', I['households'] == 15928)
S = js(FP, FPR + 'SERVICE_2016_FINAL.json')
rows_ = [S['anchors'][a]['rows'] for a in S['anchors']]
add('prospective final-pool people', '23,684', MAIN + ':361', FP, FPR + 'SERVICE_2016_FINAL.json', '/anchors/*/rows', rows_, rows_[0],
    'read (same rows every anchor)', set(rows_) == {23684})
for svc, mv in (('income_binary', '0.874'), ('civilian_at_work', '0.891'), ('public_coverage', '0.760')):
    acc = [S['anchors'][a]['services'][svc]['accuracy'] for a in S['anchors']]
    mean = sum(acc) / len(acc)
    add(f'2016 frozen service mean accuracy {svc}', mv, MAIN + ':111-112', FP, FPR + 'SERVICE_2016_FINAL.json',
        f'/anchors/*/services/{svc}/accuracy', acc, round(mean, 3), 'mean over three anchors, round 3', f'{mean:.3f}' == mv)


for c in ('Q', 'D17'):
    rows_h = [r for r in I['descriptive'] if r['id'].split('|')[1] == 'recovery_over_H' and r['id'].split('|')[2] == c]
    vals = {f"{r['role']}|{r['weighting']}": [r['estimate'], r['lower_unadjusted_95'], r['upper_unadjusted_95']] for r in rows_h}
    excl = sum(1 for v in vals.values() if v[1] > 0)
    add(f'2016 {c} measured recovery beyond H (descriptive, unadjusted 95%)',
        'not in main.tex@55c0c5a35 or Downloads PDF; guarantee review P-1 asks for it', 'main.tex:365 (P-1 wording), :127-133',
        FP, FPR + 'INFERENCE_2016.json', f'/descriptive[id=descriptive|recovery_over_H|{c}|*]', vals,
        {'estimates_positive': sum(1 for v in vals.values() if v[0] > 0), 'intervals_excluding_zero': excl},
        'count estimate>0 and lower_unadjusted_95>0', True,
        'Positive = release adds measured recovery beyond the fixed service H. Passing the J-relative clauses is not "adds nothing beyond H".')

json.dump(rows, sys.stdout, indent=1)
print(file=sys.stderr)
print(f'{sum(r["match"] for r in rows)}/{len(rows)} match', file=sys.stderr)

Q development recovery over H is positive on 8/8 endpoints (0.00086-0.00614); 2016 Q recovery over H positive 8/8 with 6/8 unadjusted 95% intervals excluding zero; neither appears in the manuscript tables.
Null-extension calibration: independent_token (population increment 0) yields finite increments in [-0.00036, +0.00077]; constant_best is routed as H and is exactly 0.
